verdict: Jira Service Management: Choose Jira Service Management when ITSM must sit on Jira Cloud — not as a Jira Software licence and not as ServiceNow. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Assets and help center on paid clouds
weaknesses: Easy to confuse with Jira Software
bestFor: Teams already on Jira Cloud who need a service desk
IT/HR/ops request management next to engineering issues
Buyers who want a published agent SKU under ServiceNow TCO
notIdealFor: Enterprises whose primary need is ServiceNow CMDB + ESM
SMBs that want Freshservice’s simpler ITSM UX without Jira
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose Jira Service Management when ITSM must sit on Jira Cloud — not as a Jira Software licence and not as ServiceNow. Compare Freshservice for a dedicated ITSM SKU; ServiceNow for enterprise ESM.
